messages:
Sam Ortega: Quick thread to sketch a 'bridge playbook' for model onboards that need backwards-compatible migrations. Goal: single onboarding artifact + explicit rollback/runway rules.

Priya Mehta: Love it. Key ask from PM: surface whether a model requires a compatibility shim and how long that shim must be supported.

Julian Park: Proposal: artifact keys include artifact_version, model, version, run_ts, slices_csv, quality_deltas_csv, regression_budget_pp, lat_p95_ms, cost_delta_pct, embed_schema_version, shim_required_bool, shim_ttl_days, smoke_pass_bool, privacy_ok_bool, kms_id, artifact_audit_id, migration_plan_ref. Store at s3://redwood-evals/<model>/<version>/<run_ts>/artifact.json

Kenji Saito: Rollout rules: if shim_required_bool=true then lane=Medium/High and require manual canary + 14d enterprise soft-pin. If shim provided, shim_ttl_days default 90. Auto-block if any quality_delta > regression_budget_pp OR smoke_pass_bool=false OR privacy_ok_bool=false.

Sam Ortega: Canary plan: default 5% or 10k requests, 7-day window; ramp steps 0.5% -> 2% -> 5% with health checks after each step. Auto-fallback if anomaly_rate >0.5% for 10m or p95 increase >30% vs baseline for 15m.

Priya Mehta: Deprecation runway: paid tenants get 30-day notice plus either shim or migration task; self-serve 7 days. Exempt tenants (legal/KMS) must have explicit migration_plan_ref and will get a bespoke timeline. Log notices in artifact: retire_notice_ts and migration_task_link.

Julian Park: Infra: we'll read artifact and evaluate simple rules. API: POST /inspectArtifact(path) -> {status, blocking_reasons} and POST /rollouts/{id}/pause/revert requires artifact_audit_id. Also emit audit events with approver ids.

rollout-bot: CI: queued benchmark for model "bridge-compat-rc" job=bmk-318888-01 ETA~2h.

Kenji Saito: Legal: EEA tenants require privacy_ok_bool=true and kms_id present or block. Add retention: artifact immutable + stored 180 days.

Sam Ortega: Next steps: I'll write a one-page playbook with example artifact and an example rollback runbook. Priya/Julius/Kenji review and we'll tag infra to wire the inspectArtifact API. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
